column1: # The C++ objects of the exe's CRT that the platform builds: one row per Wine 9.0 definition (platform/com/gen_cxx.py reads this file).
# fn   <symbol>  <MSVC decorated name>  <C signature: return(args), `this` first>  <citation wine-9.0:<path>:<function>>
#   the decorated name gives the calling convention and the stack words (contract/proto.py, the one decoder); the signature is checked against it

# class <name>  <MSVC type name>  <size>  <bases, ; separated, in Wine's order or ->  <vtable slots (fn symbols), ; separated or ->  <cxx: - | info | throw>  <copy ctor fn or ->  <destructor fn or ->  <citation>
#   cxx info: the class has a CatchableType; throw: it also has a ThrowInfo (destructor required); a base of a class named here must have cxx info
